compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The outbound Jira comment dedup key is one composition of functions in the differ and the send is a different composition in the adapter, so every convergence bug has been a point where the two drifted: `fit_comment_as_sent` (`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:283`) re-runs the send's fit to stay equal to `acli_cli_ops.add_comment:531`; the key-side `codec.normalize_outbound(...)` at `outbound_comments.py:572` is still an unmatched extra step; the truncation suffix literal lives in three places (`adapters/jira/comment_limits.py:46`, `adf.py:333`, `jira_family/rich_text.py:69`) and the limit in four (32767 ×3 vs 32000 at `adf.py:332`); decoration happens in the differ and fitting in the adapter, which sheared the marker (`unreal-empathetic-illadopsis`). Landed fixes `8209097fa9` (one decoder) and `46575522d6` (DC fit on the send path) corrected two drifts; the structure that produced five tickets (`irongrey-chubby-oxpecker`, `abusive-pebbly-sakimonkey`, `aragonite-bleached-vipersquid`, `unreal-empathetic-illadopsis`, `community-sediment-snipe`) remains. Open story `marshy-chummy-coot` is the escape analysis of the first; this story is the structural remedy.

## Approach
Add `fit_for_send(body, codec, fit) -> FittedComment(landed_text, wire_body)` in `outbound_comments.py` (core names no vendor; `fit` injected): `wire_body = fit_preserving_marker(decorate(body), fit)` computed once, `landed_text = strip_marker(codec.decode_inbound(codec.to_wire(wire_body)))`. The differ keys on `landed_text`; the mutation carries `wire_body`; Cloud and DC `add_comment` only encode and send. One suffix and one limit constant in `jira_family/rich_text.py`; delete the copies. Guard: the suffix literal and the 32767/32000 constants appear once in `src/rebar`.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py`, `adapters/jira/backend.py`, `adapters/jira/acli_cli_ops.py`, `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py`, `adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py`, `adapters/jira/comment_limits.py`, `adapters/jira/adf.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fit_for_send.py` (new).

## Testing
Happy path over the captured corpus `tests/fixtures/cloud_adf_corpus/bodies_*.json` (from `scripts/capture_jira_fixtures.py`): for every body, `landed_text` equals the decoded readback of `wire_body`. Edge: a body over the limit keeps the marker and the key still matches; DC bodies fit at `comment_max_chars()`. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py`, `test_dc_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py`, `test_outbound_comment_marker_survives_truncation.py`, `test_acli_comment_adf_encode.py`, `test_rich_text_codec.py`, `test_backend_neutrality.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For every corpus body, key equals readback; checked by the new corpus test.
- [ ] `grep -rn "32767\|32000" src/rebar/_engine` returns one file; checked by the grep and the guard test.
- [ ] Pinning suites pass unchanged; checked by `pytest`.
